Package dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.gui.background

Record Class MenuBackgroundResult

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.gui.background.MenuBackgroundResult
Record Components:
chosenBy - the name of the plugin whose resolver chose the texture, or null when the rules in guis.yml did
rulesApplied - whether the menu has rules in guis.yml and their when allowed them to run
variant - the variant the rules chose, or -1 when none matched
layers - the layers the rules added, in drawing order
texture - the glyphs in front of the menu name, coloured and followed by their reset; empty when the menu wears no texture
nameShown - whether the menu name follows the texture
title - the full title: the texture and, when shown, the name
public record MenuBackgroundResult(@Nullable String chosenBy, boolean rulesApplied, int variant, @NotNull List<Integer> layers, @NotNull String texture, boolean nameShown, @NotNull String title) extends Record
The texture one menu wears for one viewer, and how it was chosen.

The menu's title is the texture followed by the menu name, unless the name is hidden. Variant and layer numbers count the rules of the menu's background block in guis.yml from 0, in the order written; when an add-on resolver chose the texture they describe what the rules would have chosen.

Since:
1.15.0
